 Bigg Boss 20: Qazi Touqeer Leads Week 7 Popularity Rankings, Arishfa Khan Takes Second Spot
 Qazi Touqeer has secured the top position in the week 7 popularity rankings for Bigg Boss 20, according to media reports. Arishfa Khan follows in second place, while ScoutOP, Gullu and Kanika Mann complete the top five.
 Parthana Bora 
 27 Oct 2026 
 17:05
 IST Follow Us
 New Update Bigg Boss 20 is approaching the two-month mark, with competition among the contestants intensifying with every passing week. After seven weeks, 12 contestants, including a wildcard entrant, remain in the race for the trophy. According to media reports, singer Qazi Touqeer has emerged as the most popular contestant in the latest week 7 rankings, continuing to attract attention and support from viewers.  
 Advertisment Top 5 Most Popular Bigg Boss 20 Contestants in Week 7 
 According to media reports, the latest popularity rankings for Bigg Boss 20 feature Qazi Touqeer at the top, followed by Arishfa Khan. ScoutOP, Gullu and Kanika Mann occupy the remaining positions in the top five. 
 The rankings reflect the popularity of the contestants outside the house as the competition progresses. 
 Qazi Touqeer Continues To Lead The Popularity Race 
 Qazi Touqeer has maintained his position at the top of the popularity charts, with fans continuing to support him on social media and in audience polls. His growing recognition has also brought him attention beyond the reality show. 
 Advertisment View this post on Instagram 
 During a recent Weekend Ka Vaar episode hosted by filmmaker Rohit Shetty, Qazi received an encouraging offer that could open up a new opportunity in the music industry. 
 Rohit Shetty offered Qazi a playback singing opportunity for a romantic track in one of his upcoming films, should he make a film featuring such a song. Encouraging the contestant, the filmmaker said, “Aapka time agaya hai,” which translates to “Your time has come.” 
 The exchange became a notable moment in Qazi's journey on the show, with the offer adding to his growing visibility beyond the Bigg Boss house. 
 Arishfa Khan Secures Second Position 
 Arishfa Khan has claimed the second spot in the week 7 popularity rankings, placing her among the leading contestants in the latest list. 
 View this post on Instagram 
 ScoutOP, also known as Tanmay Singh, occupies the third position, while Gullu has secured fourth place. Actress Kanika Mann completes the top five. 
 With the competition becoming more intense, the contestants will be looking to strengthen their connection with viewers and maintain their popularity as the show progresses. GIVE A BETTER HEADLINES GIVEOPTIONSS LONG 
 Conclusion 
 As Bigg Boss 20 moves into the coming weeks, popularity outside the house could remain an important talking point among fans. While Qazi Touqeer currently leads the reported rankings, changing audience preferences, upcoming tasks and eliminations could influence the competition. It remains to be seen whether he can maintain his position or another contestant will emerge as a fan favourite.
